checked.evidence: runDeveloperAuthentication installs one task/id and busy before awaiting; task includes real material verification/account opening/Auth setup and action. Both terminal branches run finish inside the task, with exact operation id guard; external caller cancellation targets that exact task. No outer stale defer clears a new owner.

acquireAfterDrainingDeveloperAuthentication cancels and awaits the exact task.result, then verifies busy false, epoch unchanged and no replacement operation before acquiring cleanup. Another entered operation wins instead of losing its challenge. Auth clearPending runs only after actual action returns and its own busy defer releases. Logout sets local deny before same account credential erase; a possible already-confirmed connection fact can be returned by cancellation.

Owner uses developerOperationID plus authenticatingOperationID. Cancel/logout take a new UUID; every old result/catch/defer checks its own UUID. isWorking stays held by the current drain, so old login cannot publish a late session or clear a newer busy flag.

Owner exposes SessionObservation and bounded Challenge only. Password/code remain method inputs/temporary Auth pending state; new logs include error type only.
